formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, or WebM
baseHelp: A smaller model for clear recordings and quick transcripts.
smallHelp: A good choice for conversations, accents, and longer recordings.
turboHelp: For noisy or hard-to-understand recordings. Uses more memory.
senseVoiceHelp: For Mandarin, Cantonese, English, Japanese, and Korean recordings.
qwenPlainHelp: For Mandarin, Cantonese, and other languages. Runs on the CPU.
qwenTimedHelp: Adds local timestamp alignment for playback and subtitles. Choose the spoken language. Uses more memory.
privacy: Your audio stays on this device.
decodeError: This audio could not be read. Try another file or convert it to WAV or MP3.
modelError: The model could not load. Check your connection or try a smaller model.
transcriptionError: Transcription stopped. Try again, or choose a smaller model.
alignmentFallback: Could not align timestamps. The plain transcript is available to edit and download.
noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try a different language, model, or recording.
editHint: Select a timestamp to play from there. Edit the text before exporting.
partialHint: Completed passages are available as TXT. You can edit the finished transcript.
copyError: Could not copy. You can download the transcript instead.
